title: Detection of astrometric companions in Gaia DR4 epoch astrometry: pre-registered method, selection and predictions
author: Daniel Sandner

data.data_model: Gaia DR4 draft data model, issue D (2026-05-20); names checked on release day, any renaming reported as a deviation

controls.purpose: real epochs and real noise for injection-recovery, the noise-model check and the sampling-exact null; not assumed to be single stars
rules: astrometric_matched_transits at or above the bin's 25th percentile (sampling completeness)
scan_direction_strength_k1 and _k2 at or below the bin's 75th percentile (scan-angle coverage)
first sources by random_index (reproducible random subset)
controls.why_not_ruwe: RUWE and the excess noise are computed from residuals of the very signal tested; a cut on them selects on the outcome and removes real companions. They are recorded and used only for stratified (exploratory) reports.
controls.percentiles: from PERCENTILE_ADQL on release day (random_index < 2,000,000 per bin), recorded with the selection
controls.adql:
SELECT TOP {n} g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.parallax, g.parallax_over_error,
       g.ruwe, g.visibility_periods_used, g.astrometric_matched_transits, g.astrometric_n_obs_al,
       g.astrometric_n_good_obs_al, g.scan_direction_strength_k1, g.scan_direction_strength_k2,
       g.ipd_frac_multi_peak, g.ipd_gof_harmonic_amplitude, g.duplicated_source, g.random_index
FROM gaiadr4.gaia_source AS g
JOIN gaiadr4.all_source_flags AS f ON f.source_id = g.source_id
WHERE f.has_epoch_astrometry = 'true'
  AND g.phot_g_mean_mag >= {g_lo} AND g.phot_g_mean_mag < {g_hi}
  AND g.astrometric_matched_transits >= {matched_transits_p25}
  AND g.scan_direction_strength_k1 <= {k1_p75} AND g.scan_direction_strength_k2 <= {k2_p75}
  AND g.duplicated_source = 'false'
ORDER BY g.random_index
controls.percentile_adql:
SELECT g.astrometric_matched_transits, g.scan_direction_strength_k1, g.scan_direction_strength_k2
FROM gaiadr4.gaia_source AS g
JOIN gaiadr4.all_source_flags AS f ON f.source_id = g.source_id
WHERE f.has_epoch_astrometry = 'true' AND g.phot_g_mean_mag >= {g_lo} AND g.phot_g_mean_mag < {g_hi}
  AND g.random_index < 2000000

known_companions.size: all that pass, expected a few hundred
rules: DR3 nss_two_body_orbit astrometric solutions (Orbital, AstroSpectroSB1) with significance > 20 and period < 1500 d
planets and brown dwarfs from the NASA Exoplanet Archive with a predicted a0 > 0.1 mas

population.rule: aggregate TAP counts of DR4 nss_two_body_orbit by period and G bin; no bulk download

auxiliary: DR4 nss_two_body_orbit and spurious_signal rows of all selected sources (TAP_UPLOAD join)

method.measurement_model: w = (da + pmra t) sin(theta) + (dd + pmdec t) cos(theta) + parallax f_al + orbit (Thiele-Innes: da = B X + G Y, dd = A X + F Y); t in Julian years from J2017.5
method.input: DR4 epoch_astrometry, CCD level; CCDs with used_by_agis_al; barycentric time obs_time_tcb + obs_time_bary_corr; parallax_factor_al of the transit
method.weights: centroid_pos_error_al only (primary); centroid_pos_error_al^2 + agis_source_excess_noise^2 reported as a secondary line
method.gross_outlier_rule: drop CCDs farther than the limit from a least-absolute-deviation five-parameter fit

periodogram.model: five parameters + circular orbit (4 linear constants) per trial period

method.false_alarm_probability: 1 - (1 - p)^N, p = chi2 survival (4 dof) of the highest Delta chi2, N = span x frequency range

keplerian.candidates: 3 highest periodogram peaks and twice their periods (1 % merge)
keplerian.polish: Nelder-Mead in (log P, e, T), e < 0.95; lowest chi2 kept

method.parallax_estimate: Keplerian fit's when an orbit is detected, else the five-parameter fit's
method.noncentrality: Delta chi2 of the noise-free orbit over the best five-parameter fit (fit.orbit_noncentrality)

hypotheses.statement: The FAP approximation is not anti-conservative on DR4 sampling: in the sampling-exact null (the controls' real epochs with simulated Gaussian noise at their reported errors, 20 replicates each) the share with FAP < 0.01 is at most 0.02 and with FAP < 0.001 at most 0.004 (simulation: 0.011 and 0.002).
The reported CCD errors describe the noise: the median unit-weight error of the controls' five-parameter fits (measurement weights) lies in [0.9, 1.2] in every G bin.
hypotheses.fallback: If not, errors are rescaled per G bin by that median, H3-H5 are reported with and without the rescaling, and H2 is reported as failed.

hypotheses.statement: Injection-recovery on the controls' real epochs (orbits drawn as in AstrometricBinaryExperiment, one per control, injected into the measured w): in each non-centrality bin with at least 30 injections, (a) the detection rate (FAP < 0.001) and (b) the recovery rate (detected and the final period within 5 % of the injected one) lie within max(0.05, 2 binomial standard errors) of the predicted rates.
Weights with the source excess noise (AGIS) detect fewer injected orbits than measurement weights for non-centrality 20-80 (one-sided, paired by source, McNemar test at 0.05).
Known companions from DR3 with DR4 non-centrality (from their DR3 orbit) of at least 50: the final period lies within 5 % of the DR3 period for at least 0.81 of them (the predicted 0.91 minus 0.10).

DPAC's circular-orbit periodogram (spurious_signal.astro_circ_freq, astro_circ_freq_fap) against ours on the same sources: agreement of peak frequencies, rank correlation of FAPs, false-alarm rates. Exploratory because the draft data model leaves these columns' definitions open (TODO).
Companion fraction among controls, estimated as (detection rate - false-alarm rate) / completeness, by G bin; stratified by RUWE.
Comparison with DR4's own orbit solutions (nss_two_body_orbit) for sources both detect: period, a0, eccentricity.
Parallax shift between the five-parameter fit and the pipeline for detected orbits, by period (the simulation predicts the largest near one year).

analysis_after_release: Resolve the selection percentiles; run the selection ADQL; store ADQL, IDs, files and SHA-256.
Fetch epoch astrometry (DataLink, batches of 1,000) and the auxiliary rows.
Run the method above unchanged (the registered commit) on: the sampling-exact null (H1), the controls' five-parameter fits (H2), injections into the controls (H3, H4), the known companions (H5).
Report every hypothesis, passed or failed, with the numbers; then the exploratory analyses, labelled so.
deviations: Any change to selection, method or analysis after this record is reported with its reason and the result under the registered version where it can be computed.

simulation.model_defaults: AstrometricBinaryExperiment defaults (simplified Gaia-like sampling, sigma_al 0.2 mas per transit)
